text:
The deed gives the friend a fee simple subject to an executory limitation, with a shifting executory interest in the sister's children who reach 25; because the sister is a life in being and any child born during her lifetime must reach 25 (if at all) within 21 years of her death, the class is valid under the Rule Against Perpetuities. Title is therefore in the friend, the son, the daughter, and any additional children of the sister born during her lifetime.  
CONFIDENCE: 95
